content_fields.title: Use safe parsers and never deserialize untrusted binary data (FastAPI)
content_fields.description: Parse remote content with a strict, format-aware parser and never deserialize untrusted binary formats.
content_fields.finding: Untrusted remote binary content is ingested and re-encoded with no parser restrictions.

def _image_url_to_base64(image_url: str):
    response = requests.get(image_url, stream=True)
    encoded_image = base64.b64encode(response.content).decode()

    return encoded_image
